title: Chapter 381: Kill Them
content:
Chapter 381: Kill Them

The Holy Spirit Clan and the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Everyone in the hall had their eyes circulated, as if they had guessed something.

Above, Lu Xue's face was calm, "Take them in."

"Yes, the Lord of the Palace."

The powerful human race nodded and then slowly retreated.

And just after he retreated, another human powerhouse entered the hall.

His face was a little strange, he lowered his head slightly, and spoke in a voice that could be heard in the entire hall, "Lord of the Palace, the Three Gods sent someone to come here and said he wanted to discuss it with you."

Three gods!

In an instant, the atmosphere in the hall became a little depressed.

The powerful human race couldn't help but sweat.

Everyone looked up at Lu Xue, and saw that Lu Xue's plain face finally changed a little.

There was a little chill on her pure white face, and a sneer slowly emerged from the corners of her mouth.

"Take them here too."

Lu Xue waved her hand and signaled her to retreat.

"Yes, the Lord of the Palace."

No one present questioned Lu Xue's actions.

In this way, the hall fell into peace again.

Until a moment later, several strange auras floated out of the hall.

Everyone felt something, except An Changzai, the others couldn't help looking out of the hall.

Dongdongdongdongdongdong!

The ground began to make a slight trembling sound.

Immediately afterwards, two figures appeared in everyone's sight.

One of them looks like a human figure, but is wearing a strange suit, and emits a faint holy light all over her body. She floats in the air, and behind her, there are a pair of huge wings condensed from the holy light, and the aura of the peak of the Heavenly Supreme is unobstructed. .

Another one was a huge white tiger, full of strong bloody smell and killing aura. He seemed to be just a circle bigger than an ordinary tiger, but everyone knew that this was definitely not his original one. Looks.

These are the two strong men sent by the Holy Spirit Clan and the Heavenly Demon Clan.

They are both the Supreme Heaven, which shows how much importance the two tribes attach to the human race.

At this time, they had already seen Lu Xue sitting in a high position. The powerful Holy Spirit Clan looked respectful and nodded slightly to Lu Xue, "The Great Elder of the Holy Spirit Clan, I have seen the Lord of the Human Emperor Hall."

Just like, the strong men of the Holy Spirit clan lowered their identity a little.

This made the people in the hall nod slightly, and their eyes looked at the great elder of the Holy Spirit clan a little softer.

"You are the leader of the human race today?"

A rough voice suddenly sounded from Baihu's mouth.

Everyone's eyes immediately focused on this powerful man from the Heavenly Demon Clan, and for a moment, they were tense.

Lu Xue's expression remained unchanged. She looked at Baihu and said softly, "It's me."

Baihu smiled and said, "I am the elder of the Heavenly Demon Clan. The patriarch sent me here to cooperate with the human race. However, my Heavenly Demon Clan has always respected the strong, but you seem to be a little stinky and unhappy. .”

"presumptuous!"

"Arrogant!"

"How dare you insult the Lord of the Palace!"

The powerful people in the hall burst into breath and crushed towards the great elder of the Heavenly Demon Clan.

If the entire hall had not been a natural treasure, I would have been destroyed by this terrifying aura.

Under this huge pressure, the elder of the Tiande Clan remained unchanged and looked at Lu Xue at the high position with a smile.

At this time, Lu Xue was also looking at him.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue slowly stood up, and the Xuanyuan Sword appeared in her hands at some point.

Lu Xue didn't say anything, and the elder of the Tian Yao Clan didn't say much, but his body quickly began to grow bigger and a wild aura began to burst out.

In the hall, An Chang saw this and waved his hand.

Everyone was immediately forced to retreat one after another.

The great elder of the Holy Spirit clan had a brilliant look in his eyes, and he looked at the battle in front of him with great interest.

The next moment, the sword sounded.

A sword light flashed in the hall.

When it was time to calm down, Lu Xue had already sat back.

And that day, the body of the great elder of the demon clan took a few steps back. At this moment, the slightestness in his eyes had disappeared. He stared at Lu Xue above, his voice a little unbelievable, "You are weak, very weak, you dumb It's just that sword."

That's right, he had already felt Lu Xue's breath during this battle.

To him, it was simply outrageous.

But that's it, Lu Xue forced him back with the sword.

Facing the words of the Great Elder of the Heavenly Demon Clan, Lu Xue asked back, "Give you this sword, can you use this power?"

As he said that, Lu Xue threw it gently, and the Xuanyuan Sword flew directly to the Great Elder of the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Looking at the sword floating quietly in front of me.

The elder of the Heavenly Demon Clan couldn't help but his pupils shrank slightly.

At this moment, as long as he stretched out his hand gently, this supreme treasure of the human race would be within easy reach.

A huge desire immediately invaded his mind.

He couldn't help but slowly stretched out his claws and was about to put them in his pocket.

But just as he was about to touch the Xuanyuan Sword, a faint murderous intent instantly attacked him.

Suddenly, he suddenly woke up.

After reacting, I felt cold sweat.

If he really dared to pick up the Xuanyuan Sword, he would probably not be able to get out of this door.

After thinking it through, the elder of the Tian Yao Clan chuckled and said to Lu Xue: "I am worthy of being the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace, and I am convinced."

With a whoosh.

Xuanyuan Sword returned to Lu Xue's hands.

And at this moment, there was another movement outside the hall.

"Hahahaha, the enemy is facing, and you will also have internal strife. You are worthy of being your human race."

All the living beings in the hall looked out of the hall.

I saw three strange figures slowly walking towards the hall with unrecognizable relatives.

Three gods.

tread!

The three of them walked into the hall and felt the huge malice coming from the human race. However, the three elders of the three gods smiled and looked fearless.

The elder of the Heavenly God Clan first looked at Lu Xue and smiled, "Now, even your human race is helpless against that monster. I believe you must need help now."

The elder of the Divine Power Clan immediately answered and smiled, "That's for sure. I heard that the woman from outside was seriously injured by the monster, and now she is probably dying."

The elder of the Divine Blood Clan shook his head and sneered, "It's just up to you, the human race itself, to overcome this difficulty, it's simply a dream."

"If you ask our gods, we may be willing to help you."

"Don't underestimate our gods. The foundation of the gods is not something you mortals can imagine."

It is hard to imagine that the three gods who were beaten out of their homes a few days ago would be so arrogant now.

It turned out that they had already known about the monster.

Hearing these words, the human race looked angry, the great elder of the Holy Spirit Clan frowned slightly, and the great elder of the Tiande Clan grinned.

At this time, Lu Xue finally spoke.

She looked at the elders of the Three Gods below with a contemptuous expression.

"Does it take you trash to help with a monster?"

"Since you're here, don't leave."

"Kill them."
